title: Grain yield, zinc efficiency and zinc concentration of wheat cultivars grown in a zinc-deficient calcareous soil in field and greenhouse
authors: Kalayci, M., Torun, B., Eker, S., Aydin, M., Ozturk, L., Cakmak, I.
notes: Field experiments in Eskisehir, Central Anatolia on Zn-deficient calcareous soil. 37 bread wheat + 3 durum wheat cultivars. Zn applied as ZnSO4 at 23 kg Zn/ha. 4 replications. Table 2 has grain Zn concentration data for 2 years. Durum cultivars: Kiziltan, Kunduru 1149, Cakmak 79. Grain Zn under -Zn ranged 5-8 mg/kg (year 1) and 8-11 mg/kg (year 2). Mean grain Zn: -Zn=6 (yr1), 9 (yr2); +Zn=7 (yr1), 12 (yr2).

consensus_observations.treatment_description: Soil ZnSO4 23 kg Zn/ha, 1993-1994, all cultivars mean
